checks.name: Two workstations have separate stable points and shared resources
Moving one desk moves its three devices, preserves chair and other station
Whole-station rotation uses the same parent frame for visual metadata and footprints
Device state round-trips with all instance identities and local overrides
Later copy cannot erase an earlier busy movement from the transaction
Intersecting stations are refused before commit
Stale authoring request cannot overwrite a newer revision
Save with missing resource version fails without returning a partial document
Copy after removing the other station preserves local edits and gives all new identities

limits: CPU authoring checks only; no character reachability, actual rendering or browser persistence claim.
